question: Must the deities Kālikā and Śyāmalā be bestowed across all social classes?
premises: The instruction applies to all social classes.
Kālikā is prescribed as to be given.
Śyāmalā is likewise prescribed as to be given.
inference: Kālikā and Śyāmalā are to be given in all social classes.
plain_english: Kālikā and Śyāmalā are likewise to be given in all classes.
